result.title: Climate downscaling with likelihood functional flow matching
result.summary: Decisions about heat, frost and flooding are made locally, yet reanalyses and climate models resolve tens of kilometres. Generative downscalers add kilometre-scale detail with uncertainty, but are tied to a grid, costly to sample and lack a tractable likelihood. Here we introduce CD-FFM, a functional flow-matching model that treats the high-resolution field as a continuous random field that one model can query at any location and resolution. Its velocity acts pointwise, so spatial variability comes from a noise prior fitted to the observed spectrum and every observation has an exact likelihood. Downscaling ERA5 to 1 km daily temperature over Fennoscandia, CD-FFM lowers the continuous ranked probability score by 27-31% against regression and 12-18% against a forty-times larger neural operator in each of three test years, and outperforms a CorrDiff-style diffusion model while sampling about fifty times faster. The same model transfers to precipitation and makes large kilometre-scale ensembles affordable.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CD-FFM，将高分辨率气候场视为连续随机场，用逐点速度的功能流匹配做降尺度，使单一模型可在任意位置与分辨率查询并给出精确似然；在 Fennoscandia 1 km 温度与降水上优于回归、大得多的神经算子和 CorrDiff 式扩散模型，采样快约五十倍。
AI.relevance_reason: 其与分辨率解耦的连续场表示、逐点生成机制和可计算似然，可能为 LVR 中多尺度视觉细节的表示与生成式预测的可能性评分提供参照，迁移可行性有待核查。
